title: PM quick log — launch checklist & follow-ups
content:
Quick personal log for the hosted-api feature launch (iter 1) — messy, for my eyes and async updates.

2024-05-14 morning standup notes
- On call: me + ethan (infra) + rachel (sre) until 11:30 PT.
- Goal: unblock rollout gating items and land PRD edits before final review at 3pm.

Top priorities (today)
1) Finalize PRD edits (rollout policy + telemetry)
   - Add explicit fallback flow for model variant downgrade (who: engineering).
   - Telemetry: need per-route token latency histogram, error-type tags (timeout, oom, model-mismatch). (Action: Ethan to add instrumentation, JIRA-6142 created)
   - Add rollback criteria: >1% P50 latency regression for 10m window OR >0.5% error rate on production traffic.
2) Stakeholder follow-ups
   - Ping Legal for data retention note (email thread: slack #legal-hosted, Rachel cc).
   - Ask Solutions Eng for customer-facing KB item draft by EOD (Ravi).
3) Launch checklist items to confirm
   - [ ] Canary route configured (region: us-west1) and traffic split = 5%
   - [ ] Alert playbooks uploaded to incident playbook repo (path in linked_artifacts)
   - [ ] Docs: quickstart + migration notes published under /docs/hosted-api/rollouts
   - [ ] Pricing/quotas flagged to finance for quick sanity check (Ben)

Blockers right now
- Autoscaler regression with small VM pools — causes spikes in cold-start latency. (Observed 2024-05-13 night)
  - Mitigation ideas: pin min_instances for canary, add warmup synthetic traffic. Ethan to run experiment today.
- Missing e2e test for KV cache invalidation across model-variant switch. Need SRE help to simulate.

Notes on PRD edits (draft text snippets)
- Rollout strategy: staged canary -> regional ramp -> global ramp -> commit. Each stage min 30m observation, automated health checks gate next stage.
- Fallbacks: when primary model latency or error budget exceeds threshold, route to lighter-weight quantized model or degrade to cached responses. Customer-impact table included (high/medium/low).
- Metrics: p50/p90/p99 token latency, errors by type, per-model throughput, cache-hit ratio, cost-per-token estimate.

Stakeholder messaging (short templates)
- To Sales Ops: "Heads up — new hosted-api rollout scheduled next Tue. Expect brief canary (5%). No customer-facing changes; we will notify if SLA-affecting incidents occur"
- To Enterprise customers (email draft): short notice + opt-out instructions (link). Ravi to adapt language.

To-dos (me)
- morning: merge PRD edits -> share with product leadership by 11:00.
- noon: triage infra regression with Ethan, confirm min_instances experiment plan.
- 14:00: review GH-PR-987 (console: rollout UI) and leave comments.
- 15:00: final review meeting (30m) with PL + SRE + engineering. Agenda: gating criteria, rollback steps, comms plan.
- EOD: update checklist and mark items done.

Open questions (need answers before final review)
- What's the default TTL for KV cache across variants? (engineering answer required)
- Do we have a cost cap configuration to auto-limit tokens if spend > X? (finance + infra)
- Are function/tool-calling responses covered by our telemetry today? Might need a lightweight tracer.

Post-launch monitoring plan (sketch)
- First 2 hours: 1-min dashboard refresh for latency and errors, paging on P95 > defined threshold.
- 0-24h: hourly manual check-in with oncall and product.
- 24-72h: evaluate quality regressions via sample prompt set (run subset of eval harness).

Random notes / quick scraps
- Feedback from earlier demo: PM team asked for a migration guide for customers on older API versions. Add as follow-up ticket.
- Consider adding a "safety net" route that always routes to the most-stable model for customers on critical accounts.

End log — will clean and copy to PRD later.
